message: I remember the first time we had a blackout that lasted a whole evening. While the neighbor kids were outside playing flashlight tag, I found myself in the living room, sitting on the floor with my trusty lantern glowing bright, a power bank charging my phone, and a stash of snacks ready to go. I may have gone a little overboard in preparing for emergencies, but seeing everyone else scrambling for batteries while I just flipped the switch on my lantern felt pretty great. I guess being the gloriously over-prepared person has its perks—who knew a little planning could turn a blackout into an unexpected family game night? What’s your go-to way to make the best out of a power outage?
